title: URLs: Website Addresses
drDigitalIntro:
Every website has an address called a URL.
• A URL looks like citylibrary.example or google.com.
• It tells your browser exactly where to go on the internet.
• Type it into the address bar and press Enter.
• You don't need to type the www. part — the browser adds it for you.
• The dot-com (or dot-org, dot-example) at the end is called the domain extension.

playgroundTask.goal: Type a URL to visit the City Library website

steps.say: Type citylibrary.example in the address bar and press Enter (or click Go).

drDigitalSuccess: You typed the address and went straight there, with no search in between. When you know where you are going, that is always the quicker way.
drDigitalHint: Click the address bar at the top, type citylibrary.example, then press Enter or click the Go button.
